study type: methodological study (secondary analysis of cohort data)
exposure: exclusion of participants based on socio-economic characteristics
exclusion of participants based on maternal morbidities
exclusion of participants based on lifestyle/behaviour factors
exclusion of participants based on adverse neonatal outcomes
exclusion of participants based on longer-term adverse outcomes (specifically excess postpartum weight retention)
outcome: pregnancy weight gain percentiles (median, 25th, and 75th percentiles)
cohort: The study examined pregnancy weight gain among 3178 participants of the US nuMoM2b-Heart Health Study (HHS).
finding: Except for excess postpartum weight retention, most potential exclusion criteria for pregnancy weight gain standards did not meaningfully impact chart percentiles.
